candidates.rationale: Banking software vendor serving financial institutions, not a digital bank like Nubank; different business model and buyer.

candidates.name: BlocPal
candidates.description: BlocPal fits because it is a "neo banking platform" that lets users "transact, invest, and thrive" with money services, including "borrow funds" and a "merchant-centric model", which is broadly similar to Nubank's fintech banking model.
candidates.rationale: Too small and unclear; not obviously a comparable consumer digital bank at Nubank’s scale or market.

candidates.name: audax
candidates.description: audax fits because it offers a "digital banking platform" and enables "full digital banking, open banking and Banking-as-a-Service", which closely matches the target trait.
candidates.rationale: Banking software vendor, not a digital bank serving consumers like Nubank; different model and buyer.

candidates.name: MovoCash, Inc.
candidates.description: MovoCash fits because it is an "ON-DEMAND Mobile Banking" and "digital banking" product with "payment functionality", "digital CASH Cards", and account services, which aligns with Nubank-like consumer fintech banking.
candidates.rationale: Digital banking/fintech, but much smaller US mobile-banking product; not clearly comparable scale or Latin American consumer market like Nubank.

candidates.name: ONOFF.co
candidates.description: ONOFF.co fits because it describes itself as "Fintech for Brazil to Global Exports" and includes "Digital Banking Platform in Europe", "Multi-currency Digital Bank in Europe", and "Digital Banking", which places it in the same broad category.
candidates.rationale: Too vague and appears to be an exporter-focused fintech; not clearly a comparable consumer digital bank like Nubank.

candidates.name: BOS Digital Core Banking Platform
candidates.description: BOS Digital Core Banking Platform fits because it is a "Core Transaction Solution for FinTechs and Challenger Banks" and a "cloud-native core banking engine", which is directly relevant to digital banking platforms.
candidates.rationale: Core banking software vendor serving fintechs; not a digital bank like Nubank.

candidates.name: Scallop
candidates.description: Scallop fits because it provides an "integrated financial platform" with "multi-currency accounts", "physical and virtual debit cards", "cross-border payment infrastructure", and "Banking-as-a-Service", which is very similar to a Nubank-style fintech bank.
candidates.rationale: Scallop is a BaaS/cross-border platform, not a consumer digital bank like Nubank; different customer base and model.

candidates.name: Blend
candidates.description: Blend fits because it is a leading "origination platform for digital banking solutions" used by banks and fintechs, and the description is clearly within the digital banking/financial services space.
candidates.rationale: Blend is a banking software vendor serving banks/fintechs, not a digital bank like Nubank.

candidates.name: Nimo Industries
candidates.description: Nimo Industries fits because it delivers "all your digital banking needs" through an online lending channel for banks and lenders, which is related to the broader digital banking and fintech trait.
candidates.rationale: A lending-channel vendor for banks, not a consumer digital bank or fintech platform like Nubank.

candidates.name: Tyfone, Inc.
candidates.description: Tyfone fits because it is a "digital banking & payments provider" with a retail/commercial digital banking platform, which strongly overlaps with Nubank’s digital banking and fintech offering.
candidates.rationale: Tyfone is a banking technology vendor serving banks, not a consumer digital bank like Nubank.

candidates.name: Linker Finance
candidates.description: Linker Finance fits because it provides "The Digital Banking Experience" with "Online Deposit Account Opening" and "Digital Banking" for banks, which is closely aligned with the target trait.
candidates.rationale: B2B banking software/provider for banks, not a consumer digital bank like Nubank; different customer base and model.

candidates.name: Hatch Bank
candidates.description: Hatch Bank fits because it supports fintech partners with "lending, credit and deposit solutions" and lists "BaaS" and "digital banking" among its specialties, matching a Nubank-like fintech banking profile.
candidates.rationale: Hatch Bank is a BaaS provider serving fintechs, not a consumer digital bank like Nubank; different model and customer base.

candidates.name: Advapay
candidates.description: Advapay fits because it develops "Digital Core Banking platform" products for "digital banks" and "payment institutions", which is directly relevant to the target fintech/digital banking trait.
candidates.rationale: Advapay is a banking software vendor serving digital banks, not a digital bank or fintech consumer platform like Nubank.

candidates.name: Q2
candidates.description: Q2 fits because it provides "digital banking and lending solutions" and "Banking as a Service" for banks and fintech companies, which is very similar to Nubank’s digital financial services model.
candidates.rationale: Q2 is a banking software provider/BaaS vendor, not a consumer digital bank like Nubank.

candidates.name: Itexus
candidates.description: Itexus fits because it builds fintech software including "digital wallets", "mobile banking and neobank platforms", "virtual and physical cards", and "digital lending", which is highly aligned with the target trait.
candidates.rationale: Fintech software vendor and developer, not a digital bank/neobank like Nubank; serves the category rather than competing in it.
